articles.title: Acting U.S. Navy Surgeon General, Texas-based Sailors honor enduring legacy at 251st birthday ball
articles.summary: The acting U.S. Navy surgeon general joined local leadership, Sailors, and community members in the heart of "Military City, U.S.A.," to celebrate the Navy’s 251st birthday at the South Texas Navy Region Ball, Oct. 17, 2026.

articles.title: NEBRASKA GUARD CYBER TEAM HELPS RESTORE ESSENTIAL SERVICES IN NORTH PLATTE
articles.summary: NORTH PLATTE, Neb. — An 11-Soldier Nebraska Army National Guard team helped restore essential city and county services and strengthen network defenses during a state active-duty response Oct. 9–13, 2026, following a cyber incident affecting North Platte and Lincoln County.

articles.title: NEWLY PROMOTED COLONEL CELEBRATES MILESTONE AT CANTIGNY PARK IN WHEATON
articles.summary: Illinois Army National Guard Col. Justin Kramer, the Illinois National Guard Human Resources Policy Officer, was promoted to the rank of colonel Oct. 18 at the 1st Infantry Division Pavilion, 1st Infantry Division Museum, Cantigny Park in Wheaton.

articles.title: Why I Serve- Olena Terzi
articles.summary: U.S. Spc. Olena Terzi discusses her military service. A native of Ukraine, Terzi settled in the United States and is currently pursing various passions to give back to the community that welcomed her and her family.

articles.title: Illinois Army National Guard Activates 217th Military Intelligence Battalion
articles.summary: The Illinois Army National Guard activated the 217th Military Intelligence Battalion during a ceremony on Oct 18, 2026, in Cantigny Park, Illinois, formally establishing a new organization designed to strengthen military intelligence and electronic warfare capabilities.

articles.summary: Retired Lt. Col. David Gauntlett received the Bronze Star Medal with Valor during an Oregon National Guard ceremony at the Maj. Gen. George White Building in Salem, Ore., Oct. 19, 2026. The award recognizes his actions as a 20-year-old U.S.

articles.title: Sacramento District puts new USACE governance framework into action
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Sacramento District is putting new Headquarters governance requirements into practice through its inaugural District Engineering Review.

articles.title: Pentagon weighs force posture, costs of rebuilding Middle East bases
articles.summary: “We’re meeting with CENTCOM and doing the assessments right now from an installation perspective. Part of this is what will the global posture be in the future, and what does that require us to have?” a senior defense official told reporters today.

articles.title: Brig. Gen. Richard Cipro, a Massachusetts Guardsman, takes command of the 42nd Infantry Division
articles.summary: LATHAM, New York —Army National Guard Brig. Gen. Richard P. Cipro, a Worcester, Massachusetts resident and a veteran of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, took command of the National Guard’s 42nd Infantry Division during a ceremony at New York National Guard headquarters in Latham, New York on October 17.

articles.title: US Army support for Golden Dome missile shield takes shape
articles.summary: A U.S. Army air defense unit has been "earmarked" for support of the Golden Dome for America project, an Army official confirmed.

articles.title: USACAPOC(A) Soldiers earn Jungle Tabs in Panama, build Army Reserve capability
articles.summary: COLÓN, Panama — Eleven U.S. Army Reserve Soldiers assigned to U.S. Army Civil Affairs and Psychological Operations Command (Airborne) earned the Jungle Tab after completing the Jungle Operations Training Course-Panama Aug. 2, adding jungle expertise to the command’s Civil Affairs and Psychological Operations formations.

articles.title: Cadets Explore Human-Machine Teaming Through Hands-on Research
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Academy cadets are exploring how emerging technologies influence human behavior and decision-making through hands-on research with humanoid robots and robotic dogs.

articles.title: Blair: Serving her country through patient care
articles.summary: U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Autumn Blair is carving her own path as a dedicated flight medic while also serving her country like her parents and grandfather.

articles.title: US Air Force F-22 pilot controls unmanned FQ-44 in flight
articles.summary: The fighter jet’s pilot served as an airborne “quarterback” and gave high-level directives to an Anduril-made Collaborative Combat Aircraft.

articles.title: China built more than twice naval tonnage of US in 2024-25: Euronaval
articles.summary: China built more than twice the naval tonnage of the U.S. in the 2024-25 period, narrowing the gap between the two countries’ navies, a new report says.

articles.title: Washington Guard commanders focus on readiness, soldier care ahead of NTC

articles.title: MICC - Fort Eustis delivers joint quality-of-life solution, advances 2026–2027 campaign plan
articles.summary: U.S. Army Mission and Installation Contracting Command Fort Eustis recently executed a task order supporting the installation of an interim BeaverFit fitness facility at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma, demonstrating how responsive interservice collaboration can deliver timely quality-of-life improvements for service members.

articles.title: Soldiers put Picatinny’s Common Lethality Integration Kit to the test at PC‑C6
articles.summary: PICATINNY ARSENAL, N.J. - One of the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Armaments Center’s proudest accomplishments stood front and center before the warfighter in July, as Soldiers attending Project Convergence-Capstone 6 (PC-C6) tested out the Picatinny Common Lethality Integration Kit (CLIK).

articles.title: Chinese Navy Shadows USS Charleston Near Contested Sabina Shoal
articles.summary: MANILA, Philippines — USS Charleston (LCS-18) was tracked by Chinese forces on Tuesday after the ship “illegally intruded” into the area surrounding a contested South China Sea maritime feature, according to Beijing. Chinese forces were dispatched to monitor the Independence-class LCS near Sabina Shoal early Tuesday, the PLA said.

articles.title: Utah EOD Airmen adapt dismounted operations to emerging drone threats
articles.summary: The battlefield is changing. Drones can turn the sky into a threat, explosive hazards can hide in unfamiliar terrain, and the equipment needed to survive a mission may be limited to what an Airman can carry on their back.

articles.title: US Navy, Gecko Robotics surge AI maintenance contract to $300M
articles.summary: Gecko Robotics uses drones, wall-climbing robots and fixed sensors to gather data on components, decks, welds and hulls.

articles.title: Army Veterinary Officers Complete Specialized Dairy Pasteurizer Audit Training in Denmark
articles.summary: Thirteen U.S. Army Veterinary Corps officers recently completed Europe Dairy Pasteurizer Audit Training in Kolding, Denmark by participating in specialized technical instruction and on-site field evaluations across eight Danish dairy manufacturing facilities.

articles.title: Army Medical Service Corps Officer Serves as Liaison to German Military Medical Forces
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Medical Command recently established its first medical officer liaison position with the German military’s medical service in Bonn, Germany. Col. Kenneth Spicer, a U.S. Army Medical Service Corps officer, assumed the role in August 2025.
